<title>Regroupement des Sénégalais du Nord de l'Ontario</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bricolage+Grotesque:wght@600;700;800&family=Figtree:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap">
<style>
  /* Concept : un réseau communautaire moderne. Cartes arrondies, vert profond du logo, or et rouge en touches. Le logo repose sur une plaque blanche dans les deux thèmes. */
  :root {
    --bg: #F4F7F1;
    --surface: #FFFFFF;
    --surface-2: #EDF3EA;
    --fg: #10231A;
    --muted: #4F6154;
    --line: #DCE5D8;
    --green: #0B6B3A;
    --on-green: #FFFFFF;
    --green-soft: #E1F0E6;
    --deep: #0A3D24;
    --on-deep: #F2F7F0;
    --on-deep-muted: #BCD2C2;
    --gold: #E9B824;
    --on-gold: #1A1405;
    --red: #C42A30;
    --danger-soft: #FBE9E9;
    --plate: #FFFFFF;
    --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(16,35,26,.06), 0 8px 24px rgba(16,35,26,.06);
    --font-display: 'Bricolage Grotesque', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif;
    --font-body: 'Figtree', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
  }
  @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
    :root:not([data-theme="light"]) {
      --bg: #0C1610; --surface: #14241B; --surface-2: #1A2E22; --fg: #E8EFE4; --muted: #A3B4A5; --line: #27392D;
      --green: #5CC98B; --on-green: #07150D; --green-soft: #17301F; --deep: #0F2C1C; --on-deep: #F2F7F0; --on-deep-muted: #B4C9B9;
      --gold: #F0C43A; --red: #EE6A6E; --danger-soft: #331A1C; --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.4), 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
      color-scheme: dark;
    }
  }
  :root[data-theme="dark"] {
    --bg: #0C1610; --surface: #14241B; --surface-2: #1A2E22; --fg: #E8EFE4; --muted: #A3B4A5; --line: #27392D;
    --green: #5CC98B; --on-green: #07150D; --green-soft: #17301F; --deep: #0F2C1C; --on-deep: #F2F7F0; --on-deep-muted: #B4C9B9;
    --gold: #F0C43A; --red: #EE6A6E; --danger-soft: #331A1C; --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.4), 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
    color-scheme: dark;
  }

  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { html { scroll-behavior: auto; } * { transition: none !important; } }
  body { background: var(--bg); color: var(--fg); font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.6; padding-inline: 1rem; padding-block: 0; }
  h1, h2, h3 { font-family: var(--font-display); text-wrap: balance; line-height: 1.1; margin: 0; letter-spacing: -0.015em; }
  h1 { font-size: clamp(2.3rem, 6.2vw, 4rem); font-weight: 800; }
  h2 { font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 4.2vw, 2.6rem); font-weight: 800; }
  h3 { font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 700; }
  p { margin: 0; }
  ul, ol { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
  a { color: var(--green); text-underline-offset: 3px; }
  a:focus-visible, button:focus-visible, input:focus-visible, select:focus-visible, textarea:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--gold); outline-offset: 2px; }
  .wrap { max-width: 70rem; margin-inline: auto; }
  section.blk { padding-block: clamp(2.8rem, 8vw, 5rem); }
  .eyebrow { display: inline-block; font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .09em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--green); margin-bottom: .7rem; }
  .lede { color: var(--muted); max-width: 40rem; margin-top: .9rem; font-size: 1.06rem; }

  /* Boutons */
  .btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .5rem; min-height: 2.9rem; padding: .6rem 1.4rem; border-radius: 999px; border: 1.5px solid transparent; font: 700 1rem var(--font-body); text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .15s, background .15s; text-align: center; }
  .btn:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); }
  .btn-primary { background: var(--green); color: var(--on-green); }
  .btn-gold { background: var(--gold); color: var(--on-gold); }
  .btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--fg); border-color: var(--line); }
  .btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--surface-2); }
  .btn-light { background: var(--on-deep); color: var(--deep); }
  .btn-outline-light { color: var(--on-deep); border-color: var(--on-deep-muted); background: transparent; }
  .btn-sm { min-height: 2.3rem; padding: .3rem 1rem; font-size: .92rem; }
  .btn-danger { background: var(--danger-soft); color: var(--red); border-color: transparent; }
  button:disabled { opacity: .6; cursor: progress; }

  /* Bande + en-tête */
  .stripe { height: 6px; margin-inline: -1rem; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
  .stripe i:nth-child(1) { background: #00853F; } .stripe i:nth-child(2) { background: #FDEF42; } .stripe i:nth-child(3) { background: #E31B23; }
  header.top { position: sticky; top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px); z-index: 20; margin-inline: -1rem; padding-inline: 1rem; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 88%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
  header.top .wrap { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: .6rem 1.2rem; padding-block: .7rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .7rem; min-width: 0; background: none; border: 0; padding: 0; color: var(--fg); cursor: pointer; text-align: left; font: inherit; }
  .brand .plate { width: 3.1rem; height: 3.1rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--plate); display: grid; place-items: center; flex: none; border: 1px solid var(--line); overflow: hidden; }
  .brand .plate img { width: 82%; display: block; }
  .brand strong { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: .98rem; line-height: 1.15; font-weight: 800; }
  .navlinks { display: flex; gap: .2rem 1.1rem; flex-wrap: wrap; font-size: .95rem; }
  .navlinks a { color: var(--fg); text-decoration: none; font-weight: 600; }
  .navlinks a:hover { color: var(--green); }
  .acts { display: flex; gap: .5rem; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .me { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; }
  .avatar { width: 2.4rem; height: 2.4rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--green); color: var(--on-green); display: grid; place-items: center; font: 800 .95rem var(--font-display); flex: none; }
  .avatar.lg { width: 3.2rem; height: 3.2rem; font-size: 1.2rem; }
  @media (max-width: 52rem) { .navlinks { display: none; } }

  /* Hero */
  .hero { padding-block: clamp(2rem, 6vw, 4rem) clamp(2.5rem, 7vw, 4.5rem); }
  .hero-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.15fr .85fr; gap: 2.5rem; align-items: center; }
  @media (max-width: 52rem) { .hero-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .hero-logo { order: -1; } }
  .hero h1 em { font-style: normal; color: var(--green); }
  .hero .sub { margin-top: 1.2rem; color: var(--muted); font-size: 1.12rem; max-width: 34rem; }
  .actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .7rem; margin-top: 1.8rem; }
  .pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; background: var(--green-soft); color: var(--green); font-weight: 700; font-size: .88rem; border-radius: 999px; padding: .3rem .85rem; margin-bottom: 1.1rem; }
  .pill::before { content: ""; width: .5rem; height: .5rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--gold); }
  .count-line { margin-top: 1.3rem; color: var(--muted); font-size: .95rem; }
  .count-line b { color: var(--fg); font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.2rem; }
  .hero-logo { display: grid; place-items: center; }
  .logo-plate { background: var(--plate); border-radius: 32px; padding: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.8rem); box-shadow: var(--shadow); border: 1px solid var(--line); width: min(100%, 25rem); }
  .logo-plate img { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; }

  /* Cartes génériques */
  .cards { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 16rem), 1fr)); gap: 1rem; margin-top: 2rem; }
  .card { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 22px; padding: 1.4rem; box-shadow: var(--shadow); min-width: 0; }
  .card h3 { margin-bottom: .55rem; }
  .card p, .card li { color: var(--muted); font-size: .98rem; }
  .card ul { display: grid; gap: .45rem; }
  .card li { padding-left: 1.1rem; position: relative; }
  .card li::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; top: .6em; width: .45rem; height: .45rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--green); }
  .card .note { margin-top: .9rem; font-size: .88rem; background: var(--surface-2); border-radius: 12px; padding: .6rem .8rem; color: var(--muted); }
  .feat .ico { width: 3rem; height: 3rem; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--green-soft); color: var(--green); display: grid; place-items: center; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
  .feat .ico svg { width: 1.5rem; height: 1.5rem; stroke: currentColor; fill: none; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

  /* Pourquoi */
  .why-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 18rem), 1fr)); gap: .7rem 1.5rem; margin-top: 2rem; }
  .why-grid li { display: flex; gap: .75rem; align-items: baseline; padding-block: .7rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .why-grid li::before { content: ""; flex: none; width: .55rem; height: .55rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--green); }
  .vision { margin-top: 2.2rem; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: clamp(1.3rem, 3vw, 1.8rem); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.3; max-width: 44rem; }
  .vision span { color: var(--green); }

  /* Fonctionnement */
  .how { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 1rem; margin-top: 2rem; }
  @media (max-width: 52rem) { .how { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
  .org { display: grid; gap: .6rem; justify-items: center; text-align: center; }
  .org .box { background: var(--surface-2); border-radius: 14px; padding: .6rem 1rem; font-weight: 700; width: 100%; }
  .org .top-box { background: var(--green); color: var(--on-green); }
  .org .cities { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: .5rem; width: 100%; }
  .org .cities .box { font-size: .88rem; padding-inline: .4rem; }
  .org .arrow { color: var(--muted); }
  .org-list { margin-top: 1rem; }
  .principes { display: grid; gap: .5rem; }
  .principes li { padding-left: 0; }
  .principes li::before { display: none; }
  .principes b { color: var(--fg); margin-right: .4rem; }
  .enjeux { margin-top: 1rem; }
  .chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .5rem; margin-top: .8rem; }
  .chip { background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--fg); border-radius: 999px; padding: .25rem .8rem; font-size: .9rem; font-weight: 600; }

  /* Étapes */
  .steps { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 12.5rem), 1fr)); gap: 1rem; margin-top: 2rem; counter-reset: s; }
  .steps li { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 22px; padding: 1.3rem; }
  .steps .n { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 2.2rem; height: 2.2rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--deep); color: var(--on-deep); font: 800 1rem var(--font-display); margin-bottom: .8rem; }
  .steps h3 { font-size: 1.05rem; margin-bottom: .4rem; }
  .steps p { color: var(--muted); font-size: .93rem; }
  .tag { display: inline-block; vertical-align: middle; background: var(--gold); color: var(--on-gold); font: 700 .7rem var(--font-body); border-radius: 999px; padding: .1rem .55rem; margin-left: .3rem; }

  /* Galerie */
  .gal-sub { margin-top: 2rem; font: 700 1.05rem var(--font-body); color: var(--muted); }
  .gal-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 13rem), 1fr)); gap: .8rem; margin-top: .9rem; }
  .gal-tile { aspect-ratio: 4/3; border: 1.5px dashed var(--line); border-radius: 18px; background: var(--surface); display: grid; place-items: center; text-align: center; padding: 1rem; color: var(--muted); font-size: .92rem; max-width: 100%; }
  .gal-tile.video { aspect-ratio: 16/9; }
  .gal-tile b { display: block; color: var(--fg); font: 700 1.05rem var(--font-display); margin-bottom: .2rem; }
  .gal-grid img, .gal-grid video { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 4/3; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 18px; display: block; }
  .gal-note { margin-top: 1.1rem; color: var(--muted); font-size: .95rem; max-width: 40rem; }

  /* Réseaux */
  .socials { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 13.5rem), 1fr)); gap: .8rem; margin-top: 1.6rem; }
  .soc { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .8rem; padding: .9rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 18px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--fg); text-decoration: none; min-width: 0; }
  a.soc:hover { border-color: var(--green); background: var(--green-soft); }
  .soc .ico { flex: none; width: 2.6rem; height: 2.6rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--green); color: var(--on-green); display: grid; place-items: center; font: 800 .95rem var(--font-display); }
  .soc strong { display: block; font-family: var(--font-display); line-height: 1.2; }
  .soc small { color: var(--muted); font-size: .85rem; }
  .soc.off { opacity: .65; border-style: dashed; }
  .soc.off .ico { background: var(--muted); }

  /* Rejoindre */
  .join { background: var(--deep); color: var(--on-deep); border-radius: 32px; padding: clamp(1.6rem, 5vw, 3.2rem); }
  .join h2 { color: var(--on-deep); }
  .join .big { margin-top: .9rem; color: var(--on-deep-muted); max-width: 38rem; font-size: 1.08rem; }
  .join .alt { margin-top: 1.4rem; font-size: .93rem; color: var(--on-deep-muted); }
  .join .alt a { color: var(--on-deep); }

  /* Contact */
  .contact { display: grid; margin-top: 1.6rem; max-width: 38rem; }
  .contact div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 8rem 1fr auto; gap: .5rem 1rem; align-items: center; padding-block: .8rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .contact dt { color: var(--muted); font-size: .9rem; font-weight: 600; }
  .contact dd { margin: 0; font-weight: 600; overflow-wrap: anywhere; min-width: 0; }
  @media (max-width: 30rem) { .contact div { grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; } .contact dt { grid-column: 1 / -1; } }
  dl { margin: 0; }

  footer { border-top: 1px solid var(--line); padding-block: 2.5rem 3rem; margin-inline: -1rem; padding-inline: 1rem; }
  footer blockquote { margin: 0; font: 700 clamp(1.15rem, 3vw, 1.5rem)/1.35 var(--font-display); max-width: 44rem; text-wrap: balance; }
  footer small { display: block; margin-top: 1.2rem; color: var(--muted); font-size: .88rem; max-width: 40rem; }

  /* Formulaires */
  .field { display: grid; gap: .35rem; min-width: 0; }
  .field label { font-weight: 700; font-size: .92rem; }
  .field .hint { color: var(--muted); font-size: .84rem; }
  input[type=text], input[type=email], input[type=password], select, textarea { width: 100%; font: 500 1rem var(--font-body); color: var(--fg); background: var(--bg); border: 1.5px solid var(--line); border-radius: 14px; padding: .7rem .9rem; min-height: 2.9rem; }
  textarea { resize: vertical; min-height: 6rem; }
  input:focus, select:focus, textarea:focus { border-color: var(--green); }
  .grid2 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 1rem; }
  @media (max-width: 34rem) { .grid2 { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
  .check { display: flex; gap: .7rem; align-items: flex-start; font-size: .92rem; color: var(--muted); }
  .check input { margin-top: .25rem; width: 1.1rem; height: 1.1rem; accent-color: var(--green); flex: none; }
  .form { display: grid; gap: 1rem; }
  .msg { border-radius: 14px; padding: .75rem 1rem; font-size: .95rem; font-weight: 600; }
  .msg.err { background: var(--danger-soft); color: var(--red); }
  .msg.ok { background: var(--green-soft); color: var(--green); }
  .demo-banner { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--gold) 22%, var(--surface)); border: 1px solid var(--gold); border-radius: 14px; padding: .7rem 1rem; font-size: .9rem; margin-bottom: 1.2rem; }

  /* Vues */
  .view-pad { padding-block: clamp(1.5rem, 5vw, 3rem) 4rem; }
  .auth-box { max-width: 36rem; margin-inline: auto; }
  .tabs { display: flex; gap: .3rem; background: var(--surface-2); padding: .3rem; border-radius: 999px; width: fit-content; max-width: 100%; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .tabs button { border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); font: 700 .95rem var(--font-body); padding: .5rem 1.1rem; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; }
  .tabs button[aria-selected=true] { background: var(--surface); color: var(--fg); box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
  .panel-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end; gap: 1rem; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
  .toolbar { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 14rem; gap: .7rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
  @media (max-width: 34rem) { .toolbar { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
  .members { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 19rem), 1fr)); gap: 1rem; }
  .member { display: grid; gap: .7rem; align-content: start; }
  .member .top { display: flex; gap: .8rem; align-items: center; min-width: 0; }
  .member h3 { font-size: 1.08rem; margin: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
  .member .city { color: var(--muted); font-size: .9rem; }
  .member .bio { color: var(--fg); font-size: .96rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
  .member .meta { color: var(--muted); font-size: .88rem; }
  .composer { display: grid; gap: .7rem; margin-bottom: 1.2rem; }
  .composer .row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .counter { color: var(--muted); font-size: .85rem; }
  .feed { display: grid; gap: .9rem; }
  .post .head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .7rem; margin-bottom: .6rem; }
  .post .who { font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
  .post .when { color: var(--muted); font-size: .84rem; }
  .post .body { white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; color: var(--fg); }
  .post .foot { margin-top: .8rem; display: flex; gap: .5rem; }
  .empty { border: 1.5px dashed var(--line); border-radius: 22px; padding: 2rem 1.2rem; text-align: center; color: var(--muted); }
  .empty b { display: block; color: var(--fg); font: 700 1.15rem var(--font-display); margin-bottom: .3rem; }
  .toast { position: fixed; left: 50%; bottom: calc(1.2rem + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)); transform: translateX(-50%); background: var(--deep); color: var(--on-deep); padding: .7rem 1.2rem; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 600; z-index: 50; box-shadow: var(--shadow); max-width: calc(100% - 2rem); }
  .sr { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; }
  .copy { font: 600 .85rem var(--font-body); color: var(--green); background: transparent; border: 1.5px solid var(--line); border-radius: 999px; padding: .25rem .8rem; cursor: pointer; }
  .copy:hover { background: var(--green-soft); }
</style>


</head>
<body>
<div class="stripe" aria-hidden="true"><i></i><i></i><i></i></div>

<header class="top">
  <div class="wrap">
    <button class="brand" type="button" data-go="home" aria-label="Retour à l'accueil">
      <span class="plate"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="" width="200" height="122"></span>
      <strong>Sénégalais du<br>Nord de l'Ontario</strong>
    </button>
    <nav class="navlinks" aria-label="Sections" id="navlinks">
      <a href="#pourquoi" data-go="home" data-anchor="pourquoi">Pourquoi</a>
      <a href="#axes" data-go="home" data-anchor="axes">Axes</a>
      <a href="#etapes" data-go="home" data-anchor="etapes">Étapes</a>
      <a href="#galerie" data-go="home" data-anchor="galerie">Galerie</a>
      <a href="#reseaux" data-go="home" data-anchor="reseaux">Réseaux</a>
      <a href="#contact" data-go="home" data-anchor="contact">Contact</a>
    </nav>

        <p class="sub">Un réseau pour les Sénégalais et Sénégalaises de Hearst, Kapuskasing et Timmins : se retrouver, s'entraider et transmettre notre culture. Créez votre compte pour rejoindre l'annuaire et la conversation.</p>

  <section class="blk" id="pourquoi">

    <h2>Pourquoi un regroupement ?</h2>
    <p class="lede">Nous vivons dispersés dans le Nord de l'Ontario, souvent loin d'un réseau communautaire structuré. Un regroupement permettrait de :</p>
    <ul class="why-grid">
      <li>Renforcer les liens communautaires entre les trois villes</li>
      <li>Lutter contre l'isolement</li>
      <li>Accueillir et orienter les nouveaux arrivants</li>
      <li>Faciliter l'entraide entre les familles</li>
      <li>Créer une représentation communautaire reconnue</li>
      <li>Préserver la culture et les traditions sénégalaises</li>
      <li>Favoriser les liens entre les générations</li>
    </ul>
    <p class="vision"><span>Notre vision :</span> un regroupement uni, solidaire et inclusif, qui relie les Sénégalais du Nord de l'Ontario au-delà de la distance et qui transmet la culture sénégalaise aux générations à venir.</p>
  </section>

  function toast(text) {
    var t = $("toast"); t.textContent = text; t.hidden = false;
    clearTimeout(toastTimer); toastTimer = setTimeout(function () { t.hidden = true; }, 2600);
  }
  function validEmail(s) { return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/.test(s); }
  function frError(err) {
    var m = (err && err.message) || "";
    if (/invalid login/i.test(m)) return "Courriel ou mot de passe incorrect.";
    if (/already registered|already exists/i.test(m)) return "Un compte existe déjà avec ce courriel. Connectez-vous.";
    if (/not confirmed/i.test(m)) return "Confirmez d'abord votre courriel avec le message que nous venons de vous envoyer.";
    if (/password/i.test(m) && /6|8|least|short/i.test(m)) return "Le mot de passe est trop court (8 caractères minimum).";
    if (/rate|too many|seconds/i.test(m)) return "Trop de tentatives. Patientez une minute et réessayez.";
    if (/network|fetch/i.test(m)) return "Connexion impossible. Vérifiez votre accès à Internet.";
    return m || "Une erreur est survenue. Réessayez.";
  }

  /* ---------- Stockage de démonstration ---------- */
  var mem = {};
  var store = {
    get: function (k) { try { var v = localStorage.getItem(k); return v === null ? (mem[k] || null) : v; } catch (e) { return mem[k] || null; } },
    set: function (k, v) { mem[k] = v; try { localStorage.setItem(k, v); } catch (e) {} }
  };
  function demoLoad() { try { return JSON.parse(store.get("rsno_demo")) || { users: [], profiles: {}, posts: [], session: null }; } catch (e) { return { users: [], profiles: {}, posts: [], session: null }; } }
  function demoSave(d) { store.set("rsno_demo", JSON.stringify(d)); }
  function uid() { return "u" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10) + Date.now().toString(36); }
  function sha(s) {
    try {
      return crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", new TextEncoder().encode(s)).then(function (b) {
        return Array.from(new Uint8Array(b)).map(function (x) { return x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"); }).join("");
      });
    } catch (e) { return Promise.resolve(s); }
  }

  /* ---------- Couche d'accès aux données ---------- */
  var sb = null;
  var api;
  if (LIVE) {
    api = {
      init: function () {
        return new Promise(function (res, rej) {
          var s = document.createElement("script");
          s.src = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2.45.4/dist/umd/supabase.min.js";
          s.onload = function () { sb = window.supabase.createClient(CONFIG.SUPABASE_URL, CONFIG.SUPABASE_ANON_KEY); res(); };
          s.onerror = function () { rej(new Error("network")); };
          document.head.appendChild(s);
        });
      },
      session: function () { return sb.auth.getSession().then(function (r) { var u = r.data.session && r.data.session.user; return u ? { id: u.id, email: u.email } : null; }); },
      signUp: function (f) {
        return sb.auth.signUp({ email: f.email, password: f.password, options: { data: { prenom: f.prenom, nom: f.nom, ville: f.ville } } })
          .then(function (r) { if (r.error) throw r.error; return { needsConfirm: !r.data.session }; });
      },
      signIn: function (email, pass) { return sb.auth.signInWithPassword({ email: email, password: pass }).then(function (r) { if (r.error) throw r.error; }); },
      signOut: function () { return sb.auth.signOut(); },
      profile: function (id) { return sb.from("profiles").select("*").eq("id", id).maybeSingle().then(function (r) { if (r.error) throw r.error; return r.data; }); },
      saveProfile: function (id, f) { return sb.from("profiles").update(f).eq("id", id).then(function (r) { if (r.error) throw r.error; }); },
      profiles: function () { return sb.from("profiles").select("*").order("created_at", { ascending: false }).then(function (r) { if (r.error) throw r.error; return r.data || []; }); },
      posts: function () {
        return sb.from("posts").select("id,user_id,contenu,created_at,profiles(prenom,nom,ville)").order("created_at", { ascending: false }).limit(100)
          .then(function (r) { if (r.error) throw r.error; return (r.data || []).map(function (p) { return { id: p.id, user_id: p.user_id, contenu: p.contenu, created_at: p.created_at, author: p.profiles || {} }; }); });
      },
      addPost: function (uidv, txt) { return sb.from("posts").insert({ user_id: uidv, contenu: txt }).then(function (r) { if (r.error) throw r.error; }); },
      delPost: function (id) { return sb.from("posts").delete().eq("id", id).then(function (r) { if (r.error) throw r.error; }); },
      count: function () { return sb.rpc("nombre_membres").then(function (r) { return r.error ? null : r.data; }); }
    };
  } else {
    api = {
      init: function () { return Promise.resolve(); },
      session: function () {
        var d = demoLoad(); if (!d.session) return Promise.resolve(null);
        var u = d.users.filter(function (x) { return x.id === d.session; })[0];
        return Promise.resolve(u ? { id: u.id, email: u.email } : null);
      },
      signUp: function (f) {
        return sha(f.password).then(function (hp) {
          var d = demoLoad();
          if (d.users.some(function (u) { return u.email === f.email.toLowerCase(); })) throw new Error("User already registered");
          var id = uid();
          d.users.push({ id: id, email: f.email.toLowerCase(), hash: hp });
          d.profiles[id] = { id: id, prenom: f.prenom, nom: f.nom, ville: f.ville, origine: "", occupation: "", bio: "", interets: "", courriel_public: "", created_at: new Date().toISOString() };
          d.session = id; demoSave(d);
          return { needsConfirm: false };
        });
      },
      signIn: function (email, pass) {
        return sha(pass).then(function (hp) {
          var d = demoLoad();
          var u = d.users.filter(function (x) { return x.email === email.toLowerCase() && x.hash === hp; })[0];
          if (!u) throw new Error("Invalid login credentials");
          d.session = u.id; demoSave(d);
        });
      },
      signOut: function () { var d = demoLoad(); d.session = null; demoSave(d); return Promise.resolve(); },
      profile: function (id) { return Promise.resolve(demoLoad().profiles[id] || null); },
      saveProfile: function (id, f) { var d = demoLoad(); d.profiles[id] = Object.assign(d.profiles[id] || {}, f); demoSave(d); return Promise.resolve(); },
      profiles: function () { var d = demoLoad(); return Promise.resolve(Object.keys(d.profiles).map(function (k) { return d.profiles[k]; })); },
      posts: function () {
        var d = demoLoad();
        return Promise.resolve(d.posts.slice().reverse().map(function (p) { return { id: p.id, user_id: p.user_id, contenu: p.contenu, created_at: p.created_at, author: d.profiles[p.user_id] || {} }; }));
      },
      addPost: function (uidv, txt) { var d = demoLoad(); d.posts.push({ id: uid(), user_id: uidv, contenu: txt, created_at: new Date().toISOString() }); demoSave(d); return Promise.resolve(); },
      delPost: function (id) { var d = demoLoad(); d.posts = d.posts.filter(function (p) { return p.id !== id; }); demoSave(d); return Promise.resolve(); },
      count: function () { return Promise.resolve(Object.keys(demoLoad().profiles).length); }
    };
  }

  /* ---------- État et navigation ---------- */
  var me = null, myProfile = null;
  var views = { home: $("view-home"), auth: $("view-auth"), app: $("view-app") };
  function showView(name, anchor) {
    Object.keys(views).forEach(function (k) { views[k].hidden = (k !== name); });
    if (name === "home" && anchor && $(anchor)) { $(anchor).scrollIntoView(); }
    else { window.scrollTo(0, 0); }
    if (name === "app") loadApp();
  }
  document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    var go = e.target.closest("[data-go]");
    if (go) {
      e.preventDefault();
      var v = go.getAttribute("data-go");
      if (v === "app" && !me) { openAuth("login"); return; }
      showView(v, go.getAttribute("data-anchor"));
      return;
    }
    var au = e.target.closest("[data-auth]");
    if (au) {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (me) showView("app"); else openAuth(au.getAttribute("data-auth"));
    }
  });

  function setAuthTab(which) {
    var su = which === "signup";
    $("tab-signup").setAttribute("aria-selected", su);
    $("tab-login").setAttribute("aria-selected", !su);
    $("form-signup").hidden = !su;
    $("form-login").hidden = su;
    $("auth-title").textContent = su ? "Rejoindre le réseau" : "Bon retour";
  }
  function openAuth(which) { setAuthTab(which || "signup"); showView("auth"); }
  $("tab-signup").addEventListener("click", function () { setAuthTab("signup"); });
  $("tab-login").addEventListener("click", function () { setAuthTab("login"); });

  function renderHeader() {
    $("acts-out").hidden = !!me;
    $("acts-in").hidden = !me;
    if (me && myProfile) $("me-avatar").textContent = initials(myProfile);
  }

  function afterAuth() {
    return api.profile(me.id).then(function (p) { myProfile = p || { prenom: "", nom: "" }; renderHeader(); showView("app"); });
  }

  /* ---------- Inscription / connexion ---------- */
  $("form-signup").addEventListener("submit", function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    var msg = $("su-msg"); hideMsg(msg);
    var f = { prenom: $("su-prenom").value.trim(), nom: $("su-nom").value.trim(), email: $("su-email").value.trim(), ville: $("su-ville").value, password: $("su-pass").value };
    if (!f.prenom || !f.nom) return showMsg(msg, "Indiquez votre prénom et votre nom.");
    if (!validEmail(f.email)) return showMsg(msg, "Entrez un courriel valide.");
    if (!f.ville) return showMsg(msg, "Choisissez votre ville.");
    if (f.password.length < 8) return showMsg(msg, "Le mot de passe doit contenir au moins 8 caractères.");
    if (!$("su-ok").checked) return showMsg(msg, "Cochez la case pour accepter les règles du réseau.");
    var btn = $("su-btn"); btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = "Création…";
    api.signUp(f).then(function (r) {
      if (r.needsConfirm) {
        showMsg(msg, "Compte créé. Ouvrez le courriel de confirmation que nous venons de vous envoyer, puis connectez-vous.", "ok");
        return;
      }
      return api.session().then(function (s) { me = s; return afterAuth(); }).then(function () { toast("Bienvenue dans le réseau"); });
    }).catch(function (err) { showMsg(msg, frError(err)); })
      .then(function () { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = "Créer mon compte"; });
  });

  $("form-login").addEventListener("submit", function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    var msg = $("li-msg"); hideMsg(msg);
    var email = $("li-email").value.trim(), pass = $("li-pass").value;
    if (!validEmail(email) || !pass) return showMsg(msg, "Entrez votre courriel et votre mot de passe.");
    var btn = $("li-btn"); btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = "Connexion…";
    api.signIn(email, pass).then(function () { return api.session(); }).then(function (s) { me = s; return afterAuth(); })
      .catch(function (err) { showMsg(msg, frError(err)); })
      .then(function () { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = "Se connecter"; });
  });

  $("btn-logout").addEventListener("click", function () {
    api.signOut().then(function () { me = null; myProfile = null; renderHeader(); showView("home"); toast("Vous êtes déconnecté(e)"); });
  });

  /* ---------- Espace membres ---------- */
  var tabs = { feed: ["t-feed", "p-feed"], members: ["t-members", "p-members"], profile: ["t-profile", "p-profile"] };
  function setTab(name) {
    Object.keys(tabs).forEach(function (k) {
      $(tabs[k][0]).setAttribute("aria-selected", k === name);
      $(tabs[k][1]).hidden = (k !== name);
    });
    if (name === "feed") renderFeed();
    if (name === "members") renderMembers();
    if (name === "profile") fillProfile();
  }
  Object.keys(tabs).forEach(function (k) { $(tabs[k][0]).addEventListener("click", function () { setTab(k); }); });

  function loadApp() {
    if (!me) return;
    $("demo-app").hidden = LIVE;
    $("app-hello").textContent = "Bonjour " + (myProfile && myProfile.prenom ? myProfile.prenom : "");
    setTab("feed");
  }

  /* Fil */
  $("post-text").addEventListener("input", function () { $("post-count").textContent = this.value.length + " / 500"; });
  $("form-post").addEventListener("submit", function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    var msg = $("post-msg"); hideMsg(msg);
    var t = $("post-text").value.trim();
    if (!t) return showMsg(msg, "Écrivez un message avant de publier.");
    var btn = $("post-btn"); btn.disabled = true;
    api.addPost(me.id, t).then(function () { $("post-text").value = ""; $("post-count").textContent = "0 / 500"; return renderFeed(); })
      .catch(function (err) { showMsg(msg, frError(err)); })
      .then(function () { btn.disabled = false; });
  });
  function renderFeed() {
    var box = $("feed");
    return api.posts().then(function (posts) {
      box.textContent = "";
      if (!posts.length) {
        box.appendChild(h("div", { class: "empty" }, h("b", { text: "Aucune publication pour le moment" }), "Écrivez le premier message pour lancer la conversation."));
        return;
      }
      posts.forEach(function (p) {
        var a = p.author || {};
        var card = h("article", { class: "card post" },
          h("div", { class: "head" },
            h("span", { class: "avatar", "aria-hidden": "true", text: initials(a) }),
            h("div", null, h("div", { class: "who", text: fullName(a) }), h("div", { class: "when", text: (a.ville ? a.ville + " · " : "") + fmtDate(p.created_at) }))
          ),
          h("p", { class: "body", text: p.contenu })
        );
        if (me && p.user_id === me.id) {
          var del = h("button", { class: "btn btn-ghost btn-sm", type: "button", text: "Supprimer" });
          del.addEventListener("click", function () {
            if (del.getAttribute("data-sure") !== "1") { del.setAttribute("data-sure", "1"); del.textContent = "Confirmer la suppression"; del.className = "btn btn-danger btn-sm"; return; }
            api.delPost(p.id).then(renderFeed).catch(function (err) { toast(frError(err)); });
          });
          card.appendChild(h("div", { class: "foot" }, del));
        }
        box.appendChild(card);
      });
    }).catch(function (err) { box.textContent = ""; box.appendChild(h("div", { class: "msg err", text: frError(err) })); });
  }

  /* Annuaire */
  var allMembers = [];
  function renderMembers() {
    return api.profiles().then(function (list) { allMembers = list; drawMembers(); })
      .catch(function (err) { $("members").textContent = ""; $("members").appendChild(h("div", { class: "msg err", text: frError(err) })); });
  }
  function drawMembers() {
    var q = $("m-search").value.trim().toLowerCase(), v = $("m-ville").value;
    var list = allMembers.filter(function (p) {
      if (v && p.ville !== v) return false;
      if (!q) return true;
      return [p.prenom, p.nom, p.occupation, p.origine, p.interets, p.bio, p.ville].join(" ").toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1;
    });
    $("m-count").textContent = list.length + (list.length > 1 ? " membres" : " membre");
    var box = $("members"); box.textContent = "";
    if (!list.length) { box.appendChild(h("div", { class: "empty" }, h("b", { text: "Aucun membre trouvé" }), "Essayez une autre recherche ou une autre ville.")); return; }
    list.forEach(function (p) {
      var card = h("article", { class: "card member" },
        h("div", { class: "top" }, h("span", { class: "avatar lg", "aria-hidden": "true", text: initials(p) }), h("div", { style: "min-width:0" }, h("h3", { text: fullName(p) }), h("div", { class: "city", text: p.ville || "" })))
      );
      if (p.occupation) card.appendChild(h("div", { class: "meta", text: p.occupation }));
      if (p.origine) card.appendChild(h("div", { class: "meta", text: "Originaire de " + p.origine }));
      if (p.bio) card.appendChild(h("p", { class: "bio", text: p.bio }));
      if (p.interets) {
        var chips = h("div", { class: "chips", style: "margin-top:0" });
        p.interets.split(",").map(function (s) { return s.trim(); }).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 8).forEach(function (s) { chips.appendChild(h("span", { class: "chip", text: s })); });
        card.appendChild(chips);
      }
      if (p.courriel_public) card.appendChild(h("div", { class: "meta", text: "Courriel : " + p.courriel_public }));
      box.appendChild(card);
    });
  }
  $("m-search").addEventListener("input", drawMembers);
  $("m-ville").addEventListener("change", drawMembers);

  /* Profil */
  function fillProfile() {
    var p = myProfile || {};
    $("pf-prenom").value = p.prenom || ""; $("pf-nom").value = p.nom || "";
    $("pf-ville").value = p.ville || "Hearst";
    $("pf-origine").value = p.origine || ""; $("pf-occ").value = p.occupation || "";
    $("pf-bio").value = p.bio || ""; $("pf-int").value = p.interets || "";
    $("pf-share").checked = !!p.courriel_public;
    hideMsg($("pf-msg"));
  }
  $("form-profile").addEventListener("submit", function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    var msg = $("pf-msg"); hideMsg(msg);
    var f = {
      prenom: $("pf-prenom").value.trim(), nom: $("pf-nom").value.trim(), ville: $("pf-ville").value,
      origine: $("pf-origine").value.trim(), occupation: $("pf-occ").value.trim(), bio: $("pf-bio").value.trim(), interets: $("pf-int").value.trim(),
      courriel_public: $("pf-share").checked ? me.email : ""
    };
    if (!f.prenom || !f.nom) return showMsg(msg, "Le prénom et le nom sont obligatoires.");
    var btn = $("pf-btn"); btn.disabled = true;
    api.saveProfile(me.id, f).then(function () {
      myProfile = Object.assign(myProfile || {}, f); renderHeader();
      $("app-hello").textContent = "Bonjour " + f.prenom; toast("Profil enregistré");
    }).catch(function (err) { showMsg(msg, frError(err)); }).then(function () { btn.disabled = false; });
  });

  /* ---------- Copier ---------- */
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-copy]").forEach(function (btn) {
    var label = btn.textContent;
    function done(m) { btn.textContent = m; setTimeout(function () { btn.textContent = label; }, 1800); }
    function fallback() {
      var el = $(btn.getAttribute("data-target"));
      if (el) { var r = document.createRange(); r.selectNodeContents(el); var s = window.getSelection(); s.removeAllRanges(); s.addRange(r); }
      done("Texte sélectionné");
    }
    btn.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      try { navigator.clipboard.writeText(btn.getAttribute("data-copy")).then(function () { done("Copié"); }, fallback); } catch (err) { fallback(); }
    });
  });

  /* ---------- Démarrage ---------- */
  $("demo-auth").hidden = LIVE;
  api.init().then(function () {
    return api.session().then(function (s) {
      me = s;
      if (me) return api.profile(me.id).then(function (p) { myProfile = p; renderHeader(); });
    });
  }).then(function () { return api.count(); }).then(function (n) {
    if (n && n > 0) { $("count-num").textContent = n; $("count-line").hidden = false; }
  }).catch(function () {});
})();
</script>

</body>
</html>
